title: Patch: every infinite animation moves only transform and opacity
notes: Issue #3608, part of #3604: every animation that repeats forever in the web client moves only transform and opacity, so the compositor runs it and nothing repaints each frame (R3608000). Under apps/web/src/cards/ the Mythic hand shimmer draws its three-colour rim once on the hand card's ::after and the loop fades that layer's opacity alone; the rim keeps its colours, conditions and reduced-motion rest state. How cards look and play is unchanged.

player.title: Smoother glows, pulses and shimmer
fixes: Hand glows, face-down cards, the Mythic shimmer, button pulses and marching arrows look the same but animate on the compositor, so busy boards hold their frame rate on slower devices.
